notes.title: EDENGATE: The Edge of Life is a Winner for NYX Games Awards!
notes.content:
Greetings Players! 

Today, we are proud to share with you all a new goal we achieved: EDENGATE won two awards for the PC Game: [b]Silver in Indie[/b] Category and [b]Gold in Music[/b] Category!  

The [b]NYX Games Awards[/b] is an international competition that recognizes creativity and technical excellence in the Gaming Industry, and we had the chance to show our game to a talented jury made up of passionate industry veterans. 

With this message, we’d love to take the opportunity to kindly thank the jury of the [b]NYX Games Awards[/b] and to thank all of you for keep supporting us. 

HOOK Team 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42926663/00e7cf778c22ddc9fa839723c6bf6e5b0b2dbc4e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: EDENGATE: The Edge of Life is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42926663/97484ba26c0b49eb777ac0e90fdde1c0289f7813.png[/img]

We’re happy and excited to announce that our internally developed dark narrative adventure [b][i]EDENGATE: The Edge of Life[/i] is available now on Steam[/b]. 

In collaboration with the writer [b]Matthew Seiji Burns[/b] and the composer [b]Laryssa Okada[/b], we want to take you on an emotional journey through the eyes of Mia, a promising young biologist who wakes up to find herself in an abandoned hospital with no memory of the events leading up to her awakening. 

The concept and development of the game was formed during months full of isolation and uncertainty in the future, emotions that we tried to convey through the [i]EDENGATE[/i]’s experience.

[previewyoutube=8lW5czX6_FM;full][/previewyoutube]
We hope you’ll enjoy this journey to explore and discover all the secrets that lie behind Mia's story!

[i]EDENGATE: The Edge of Life[/i] is available for [b]PC[/b] via Steam and [b]PlayStation 4[/b], with the [b]Xbox One[/b] version releasing soon.
 
See you there!
 
HOOK Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42926663/4189190012c4ca0302ce5176cfb71a979d44f882.png[/img]

notes.title: New Release date: 15th November 2022
notes.content:
Hi players,

To give you the best experience possible in [i]EDENGATE: The Edge of life[/i], we have decided to slightly postpone the release of the game to[b] November 15th, 2022[/b]. These two additional weeks will allow our small dev team to polish all the necessary details.

Soon you will be able to explore and discover all the secrets that lie behind Mia's story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42926663/e664857cdd9bdf7558592ca0b4bfd5ec167ecac1.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your support and patience,

HOOK Team

notes.title: EDENGATE: The Edge of Life | Coming October 2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42926663/4189190012c4ca0302ce5176cfb71a979d44f882.png[/img]

We are excited and happy to present to the world [i][b]EDENGATE: The Edge of Life[/b][/i] with the first trailer shown during the [b][i]Tokyo Game Show 2022[/i][/b].

[previewyoutube=GqIlOLTUXhU;full][Trailer][/previewyoutube]
The project was born and developed during the difficult months of the pandemic, and it is our representation of the [b]fear [/b]and [b]isolation [/b]that we truly felt for the first time.

In [i]EDENGATE[/i], you play as [b]Mia[/b], a young scientist who has just woken up in an abandoned hospital. What happened to her? And [b]what happened to the whole world[/b]?

[i]EDENGATE: The Edge of Life[/i] will be released on[b] October 25, 2022 on Steam and consoles[/b], and we hope it will affect you as it did to us during its development.

Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/HOOKcrew]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/HOOKcrew]Facebook[/url] for all the next updates!

See you there,

Camilla from HOOK
